source_snapshot.title: UAE oil spill: Umm Al Quwain beaches closed as cleanup efforts begin
source_snapshot.text: UAE: All beaches and coastal areas in Umm Al Quwain have been temporarily closed following an oil spill from a tanker, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment has confirmed.The spill was detected by the UAE’s technical monitoring and environmental assessment system, prompting an immediate response to contain the oil and limit its impact on the marine environment.Response teams, working with local and federal authorities, have begun containment, cordoning, cleanup and remediation operations.The ministry said precautionary coastal surveys, monitoring and environmental assessments were under way to determine the extent of the impact and identify the measures needed to protect marine life..The temporary closure will remain in place until technical teams complete their assessments and establish the necessary safety and environmental protection measures, the ministry said.The ministry also addressed odours reported in Sharjah, Ajman and Umm Al Quwain, assuring residents that they pose no health risks.Fishermen and other sea users have been urged to follow official instructions and avoid fishing in affected areas while response operations continue.The ministry called on the public to rely on official sources for information and avoid spreading rumours, adding that updates would be issued on developments and the measures being taken..Strange smells reported across UAE: What authorities have found so far.Sharjah Police reassure residents over unusual odours across UAE.Oil slick from grounded ship off Oman spreads across 390 sq km.Oman says no oil spill after vessel runs aground near Hallaniyat Islands reserve

source_verification.reason: All factual claims in the post are directly supported by the source text.

claims.claim: In Umm Al Quwain, all beaches and coastal areas are temporarily closed due to an oil spill from a tanker.
The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment has begun containment and cleanup efforts and is conducting assessments to evaluate damage to the marine environment.
The closure will last until all necessary safety and environmental protection measures are completed.
Residents are advised to follow official updates and avoid fishing in affected areas.

UAE: All beaches and coastal areas in Umm Al Quwain have been temporarily closed following an oil spill from a tanker, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment has confirmed.The spill was detected by the UAE’s technical monitoring and environmental assessment system, prompting an immediate response to contain the oil and limit its impact on the marine environment.Response teams, working with local and federal authorities, have begun containment, cordoning, cleanup and remediation operations.The ministry said precautionary coastal surveys, monitoring and environmental assessments were under way to determine the extent of the impact and identify the measures needed to protect marine life..The temporary closure will remain in place until technical teams complete their assessments and establish the necessary safety and environmental protection measures, the ministry said.The ministry also addressed odours reported in Sharjah, Ajman and Umm Al Quwain, assuring residents that they pose no health risks.Fishermen and other sea users have been urged to follow official instructions and avoid fishing in affected areas while response operations continue.The ministry called on the public to rely on official sources for information and avoid spreading rumours, adding that updates would be issued on developments and the measures being taken..Strange smells reported across UAE: What authorities have found so far.Sharjah Police reassure residents over unusual odours across UAE.Oil slick from grounded ship off Oman spreads across 390 sq km.Oman says no oil spill after vessel runs aground near Hallaniyat Islands reserve

summary_ru: 🚨 В Умм-эль-Кувейне временно закрыты все пляжи и прибрежные зоны из-за разлива нефти с танкера. Министерство изменения климата и окружающей среды начало работы по локализации и очистке, а также проводит обследования для оценки ущерба морской среде. Закрытие продлится до завершения всех необходимых мер безопасности и защиты. Жителям рекомендовано следить за официальными сообщениями и избегать рыбалки в пострадавших районах.
